column1: # DEFAULT run: NA12878 (GIAB HG001) captured with the Illumina Nextera Rapid
# Capture Expanded Exome, sequenced on a HiSeq 2500 (2x101).
# This is the default because it is the only NA12878 exome used here that anyone
# can obtain: the FASTQs are public on the NCBI GIAB FTP, and the matching
# capture BED is built by `run get_capture_bed`. Kit and BED therefore agree out
# of the box, which is what makes the shipped benchmark meaningful.
# Download (~16 GB, see README "Evaluating against GIAB"):
#   https://ftp-trace.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/giab/ftp/data/NA12878/Garvan_NA12878_HG001_HiSeq_Exome/
# Two libraries (NIST7035, NIST7086), two lanes each = 4 units of one sample,
# merged per sample after alignment.
# The `library` column is what makes that true in the data as well as in this
# comment. It becomes @RG LB:, and MarkDuplicates keys duplicate detection on
# (library, 5' position) -- so without it each LANE looked like its own library
# and cross-lane PCR duplicates were never marked. The column is optional; omit it
# and each unit is treated as its own library, which is right only when that is
# actually the case.
# To run your OWN data instead, replace these rows and point intervals.bed in
# config/config.yaml at your kit's GRCh38 target BED.
sample
